reason: It's MIT and self-hostable, so if it's any good I'll spin up the Docker image on a Friday and run it myself. I'm not paying $20 a seat for a hosted early preview of something I can host, or honestly roughly build with a vector DB and an MCP server.
objection: Per-seat pricing on 30 engineers is another $7k a year line item I have to defend to finance, for a hosted version that's still in preview, holding our incident history and Slack data. Whether the briefings actually beat what our agents already get from the repo and a CLAUDE.md is unproven.
would_change_my_mind: Running the self-hosted version for a month and seeing it actually stop an agent from repeating a past incident, plus pricing per org or per agent instead of per engineer, with SSO and a data-retention story finance and security will sign.
